note: Daily figures shown in each edition, keyed by edition date. Entries marked seed were backfilled: EGX30 and the eight Egyptian stocks from investing.com history (from January 2021); Egyptian 21K gold converted from investing.com XAU/EGP (per ounce of fine gold / 31.1035 x 0.875), with goldpricez 21K prices for 14-28 October 2026; US stocks, indices, oil, global gold, bitcoin and the dollar and euro rates from Yahoo Finance market data (from January 2021; dollar and euro are market rates, not the central bank rate). A close on day D is filed under the edition of D+1. For back days, Gulf currencies against the pound were worked out from the logged USD/EGP and the dollar pegs (SAR 3.75, AED 3.6725, QAR 3.64), KWD and GBP from Yahoo Finance dollar crosses; the US dollar index (dxy) is ICE's index from Yahoo Finance; gold 24K, 18K and the gold pound (8 g of 21K) were derived from 21K. EFG Holding (HRHO), Cleopatra Hospital (CLHO), Juhayna (JUFO) and Alexandria Containers (ALCN) were added from investing.com history (from January 2021). Exxon Mobil (XOM), Broadcom (AVGO), Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) and Walmart (WMT) were added from Yahoo Finance history (from January 2021). The Dow Jones Industrial Average (dow) was backfilled from FRED's DJIA series, matched to each entry's S&P 500 close. Daily volume for the US stocks (vol) was backfilled from Nasdaq's price history from October 2025, matched to each entry's close; Egyptian volumes start on 29 October 2026.
